source_replay.limits: source assertions and replay of existing receipts; not new behavioral/native acceptance tests or causal timer attribution

portable_review.title: docs(research): investigate startup operation timeout

not_attempted.changed_profile_or_repeat: not authorized by this bounded diagnostic protocol

raw_snapshots: guest-only originals verified, sanitized and removed; no host copy; post-deletion independent re-extraction unavailable
limits: Fresh standalone diagnostic is a distinct candidate from the failed full lifecycle, even with identical binary/profile/source paths
Point samples and classified deadline errors do not identify earliest expired timer or measure phase/collector/command durations
Final independent journal readback applies only to this diagnostic, not the prior failed startup
No causal wider-caller/performance/emulation/deadlock/capacity finding; no product or native limits changed
Incomplete historical guest vectors remain unverified; later successful cleanup cannot retroactively accept them
Both full native lifecycle release gates, second clean cycle, fault families, worker provenance, backend/global launch and runtime/release acceptance remain open
